J.K FENNER (INDIA) LIMITED
JOB PROFILE 
Job Title   Branch Manager 
Location   Ahmedabad
Reporting to   Regional Manager
Age   35-40 years
Qualification:   Required   BE( Mechanical)-MBA
Experience:   Required   8 - 10 YEARS
Industry/ Company
Preference
Job Responsibilities   >Responsible for industrial products west
>Handling promotion activities of products
>Expanding the market share
>Improving sales promotion activities
>In charge of stocks in the branches
>Handling debtors
>Generating new customers by creating awareness about the products
>On the job training for sales engineers
>Co-coordinating the superiors in building new schemes
>Brand management by coordinating the advertisement department
>Market forecast/Planning.
>Customizing the product to the customers
>Customer follow up in after sales services
>Keep, tracking the market information
>Managing the sales team efficiently
>Inventory control
>Co-coordinating with R& D Department for new product development
Key Result Areas   Sales Turnover; Debtors; Bench Marking; Market Share(Volume/Value);
Attend New Customers
Skills / Competencies   Communication, Innovation, Achievement Orientation, Analytical
Skills, Conceptual Thinking, Crisis management, Decision making,
Flexibility, Influencing, Initiative, Integrity, Leadership, Learning and
sharing, Negotiation, Planning, Prioritizing, Time Management,
Mentoring.

Job Title:      Team Leader  - Sales & Marketing
Grade:           Senior Officer / Assistant Manager
Location:        Siliguri
Reporting to:  Business Head / Marketing Head
Age:              Below 35 Years
Qualification:  Graduate with any stream
Job Description:
Working on the marketing plan as framed by Marketing Head / Business Head
Working on Price List as per market input and Business Head
Ensuring POP material is available as an when required 
Look for avenues of Branding of our products at customer end
Supporting sales and lead generation efforts.
Craft strategies for all Marketing teams, including Digital, Advertising, Communications and Creative
Set, monitor, and report on team goals
Creating and managing MIS of product portfolio and segment portfolio.
Key Result areas:
> 4 years experience in auto after market  industry
Drive sales and build retail distribution
Ensure sales force effectiveness
Skills and Competencies:
Technical:
 Functional Knowledge
Managerial:
Confident leader
Excellent Interpersonal and Communication skills
Strong Performance & Development Orientation
Team Player
